# Guāndì, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Guāndì** shows up constantly.

Guāndì's myth is history sanctified: the Records of the Three Kingdoms gave him a life, the Romance gave him a legend, and eight dynasties gave him a godhood.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Guāndì
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Domain of influence:** War, Loyalty, Protection
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Defense, Military & Security
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 89 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Peach Garden.** The Romance of the Three Kingdoms opens with the oath: in a peach garden, Guān Yǔ swore with Liú Bèi and Zhāng Fēi to die on the same day as brothers.  He kept it past reason — through capture, through Cáo Cāo's gold and titles, riding a thousand miles back to his sworn lord with the general's seal hung on his gate. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**Lord of the Beautiful Beard.** Held by Cáo Cāo, he accepted three conditions only: he surrendered to the Han, not to Cáo; his brother's wives would be protected; and he would leave the moment Liú Bèi was found.  He kept all three, repaying Cáo Cāo's courtesy by beheading the enemy general Yán Liáng — honor answering honor, the episode the temples never tire of carving. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The god of war himself — loyalty as the armys oath.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Guāndì performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The deified general whose red-faced statue stood in more temples than any other figure in the Chinese world — loyalty worshipped.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Guāndì performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration

*Government, executive leadership, and statecraft. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The co-Sage of the empire; loyalty as governance.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Guāndì performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Dynasty Warriors made him a global gaming icon.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Legal, Justice & Compliance

*Law, courts, and regulatory compliance. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The enforcer of oaths; every contract sworn on his altar.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Guāndì performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Guāndì's myth is history sanctified: the Records of the Three Kingdoms gave him a life, the Romance gave him a legend, and eight dynasties gave him a godhood. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in defense, military & security, faith & spiritual organizations, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/guandi/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
